sections.en: 2 ἐπίδους ('giving') the codex has. 3 ἀλλοτρ. οἰκητήριον ('alien dwelling') noted to be transposed by Kroll. 7-8 ἐπιμηνύ- σθαι ('to be indicated') the codex has. 10 ἢ ('or') the codex has, τὸ ('the') I have written. 14 κεχριαμον' ('anointed') the codex has, κεχρειωμένον ('needed') Kroll. 15 οἴκω- θεν ('from home') the codex has. 16-17 words are corrupt. 19 ἄος ('first') the codex has, πρῶτος ('first') I have written. 26 μαρτυρεῖ ('bears witness') the codex has. 27 ἀπόκρισιν ('answer') the codex has, corrected by Kroll. 30 Ὡσ ('As') the codex has, σημαίνει ('signifies') I have written doubtfully. 35 Ἑρμῆς ἑσπέριος ἀνατολικὸς κόρας ('Mercury evening eastern girls') the codex has, Ἀφροδίτη ἑσπερία ἀνατολικὴ κόρας ('Venus evening eastern girls') I have restored. 36 aπe μέσους το^ Ἡλίου ('from the middle of the Sun'), afterwards ἄνδρας ('men') I have supplied.

summary.headline: Astrological Identification of Thieves
summary.text: Astrological rules for identifying a thief and the condition of a lost object through planetary houses, aspects, applications, phases, stations, and visibility. The passage assigns meanings to the Sun, Moon, Saturn, Mercury, and Venus, including the thief’s origin, sex, social status, and age.
